extensionDescription.message: Record meeting audio and send it to Chatterbox for transcription and summaries.

commandDescription.message: Start or stop recording the meeting

dataUseDisclosure.message: When you record, this extension captures your microphone and meeting audio, encrypts temporary audio chunks in this browser, and uploads them to the Chatterbox server you choose. That server decrypts them for storage and processing. Download a playable copy from your Chatterbox account after upload. The recorder key is encrypted in this browser. Your server operator controls data after upload. You must inform participants and obtain any required consent.

dataUseAgree.message: I understand and agree to this data handling.

dataUseRequired.message: Review the data disclosure and agree before connecting or recording.

pendingQuestion.message: Connect this recorder to the server below?

pendingWarning.message: Recordings will be sent to this server. Confirm only if you trust it.

optionsIntro.message: Open your Chatterbox instance, go to Settings → Meeting Recorder, and click Set up recorder. Or enter the details here.

pendingBuffersHint.message: Finish uploading or discard these recordings before changing the connection. Discarding permanently deletes the encrypted browser buffer.

pendingRecoveryRebind.message: My old recorder token is unavailable. I will authorize these recordings for a new token in Chatterbox settings.

autoIntro.message: Meet, Teams and Zoom web prompt you by default. Record opens the participant notice and Chrome’s audio picker. Auto also arms the toolbar for one-click recording after your policy acknowledgement. Your saved choices and server defaults take precedence. Other platforms stay Off until you or your server choose otherwise.

nudge.message: Show a notification when a meeting is detected

quietSeconds.message: Stop after this many seconds of silence (auto mode)

shortcutHint.message: Chrome may leave the suggested key unassigned; set it there if empty.

ackIntro.message: Confirm your recording policy once before using automatic recording. The confirmation time is stored with every automatic recording.

micIntro.message: Setup asks for microphone access so recordings include your voice. If access is missing, recording waits for your decision. The system default microphone is recommended.

encryptedBufferNotice.message: Encrypted chunks stay in this browser until the server confirms completion. Download a playable copy from your Chatterbox recording page.

encryptedServerRequired.message: This server does not support encrypted recording. Update your Chatterbox server before recording.

noticeHint.message: Shown before a manual recording and used for the one-time confirmation above. Leave empty to use your server's text.

popupConnectIntro.message: Connect this extension to the Chatterbox instance in the current tab. Then click Set up recorder on that page.

unpairedIntro.message: Connect the extension to your Chatterbox account to start recording.

unpairedHint.message: Open your Chatterbox instance and go to Settings → Meeting Recorder, or enter the details manually.

ready.message: Ready to record the meeting in the active tab.

pickerHint.message: Chrome will ask you to choose a tab or screen with audio.

pickerInstruction.message: Choose a tab or screen with audio in Chrome's dialog.

finishing.message: Finishing upload and handing off to Chatterbox…

processingRecording.message: Chatterbox is assembling and saving your recording…

uploadComplete.message: All $1 audio segments reached the server.

recoveryUnavailable.message: The server could not resume this encrypted recording. The browser buffer is still kept; check the paired account and key, or discard it explicitly.

partialRecoveryDetail.message: Only the first $1 of $2 segments can be saved. The rest will be lost.

partialRecoveryConfirm.message: I understand that the missing part and everything after it will be lost.

partialRecordingSent.message: Only the beginning of this meeting was saved. Open Chatterbox to review it.

noticeDefault.message: Inform participants and obtain any required consent before recording.

invalidConnection.message: Enter a server URL and recorder key. Use HTTPS, or HTTP for localhost.

sourceHasNoAudio.message: The selected source cannot share audio. Choose a browser tab, or enable system audio if your browser offers it.

accessDenied.message: Access to the server was not granted. The extension cannot upload without it.

defaultsSummary.message: Server defaults (fetched $1): $2, stop after $3 seconds of silence$4

confirmPolicy.message: Confirm the recording policy to enable automatic recording.

siteConnected.message: Connected to this site. Now click Set up recorder on the Chatterbox page.

autoTip.message: Tip: turn on automatic recording for $1 in Options, and the icon will offer to record with one click.

noMeeting.message: No meeting detected in this tab.

recordingTitle.message: Recording. Click to stop and save.

recordingSentBody.message: Your meeting was sent to Chatterbox and will be transcribed shortly.

autoActionTitle.message: Click to record this $1 meeting with Chatterbox

alreadyRecordingBody.message: Stop the current recording before starting another.

confirmationNeededBody.message: Confirm the recording policy once in the extension options, then click again.

recordingStoppedBody.message: The meeting went quiet, so the recording was saved.

micUnavailableBody.message: Only meeting audio is being recorded. $1

nothingRecordedBody.message: No audio was captured, so nothing was saved. If you used the screen picker, enable Share system audio.

unsentRecordingsBody.message: Chatterbox has buffered recordings waiting to upload. Open the extension to retry.

pairingMissing.message: Pairing message missing server URL or key

pairingOriginMismatch.message: Pairing refused: the page origin does not match the server URL

alreadyInProgress.message: A recording is already in progress

connectFirst.message: Connect the extension to Chatterbox first (open the options page).

keyRejected.message: The recorder key was rejected. Reconnect in options.

accessWithdrawn.message: Your access to Chatterbox was withdrawn. The recording is kept encrypted in this browser: once your access is restored, choose Retry upload, or sign in again and pair the recorder.

accessUnverifiable.message: The server cannot verify your access right now; the recording is kept and uploads resume automatically.

finalizeFailed.message: Could not finalize the recording. Encrypted chunks remain in this browser for recovery.

folderSearchHint.message: Type at least 2 characters to search folders.

folderSearchFailed.message: Could not load folders. Try again.

micWarning.message: Your microphone is not allowed. Allow it so your voice is included in recordings.

micGranted.message: Microphone access is allowed. Your voice will be included.

micReallow.message: Chrome has blocked this microphone. Open chrome://settings/content/microphone → Not allowed to use your microphone → Chatterbox Meeting Recorder → reset the microphone permission. Return here and allow access. If Chrome is managed, ask your administrator.

micRequestIntro.message: Allow your microphone to include your voice. Recording starts after you allow access and choose the meeting tab in Chrome. You can explicitly record meeting audio without your microphone instead.

recordWithoutMicWithConsent.message: Consent confirmed · Record without my microphone

participantAckRequired.message: Confirm the participant notice before recording.

meetingPickerHint.message: In Chrome’s picker, choose the meeting tab and enable Share tab audio.

systemSilent.message: No sound from the shared source yet. If the meeting is talking, stop and share the meeting tab with Share tab audio on.

recordingRequestExpired.message: This recording request expired or the tab changed. Start again from the meeting tab.

setupConnect.message: Allow this server and set up microphone

meetingRecordBody.message: $1 is active. Record opens Chrome's sharing dialog: choose the meeting tab and keep Share tab audio on. Clicking the extension icon records the tab without the dialog.

micDeviceMissing.message: The selected microphone is unavailable or disconnected.

micDeviceBusy.message: The microphone is busy or cannot be read. Close other apps using it.

micDeviceBlocked.message: Microphone access was blocked by Chrome or the operating system.

micDeviceEnded.message: The microphone disconnected or stopped sending audio.

micDeviceFailed.message: The microphone could not be opened. Check the input device and system settings.

setupProposalMismatch.message: This proposal came from a different server or tab than this setup. Cancel it and connect from the original Chatterbox tab.

meetingTabClosed.message: The meeting tab was closed. Open the meeting and start again.

micReminder.message: Show microphone permission reminders in the popup and toolbar
